## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? (Describe the underlying need, not just the solution — this helps figure out the best fix.)

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like to see.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why don't they fully solve the problem?

## Why This Would Be Useful

Explain who would benefit from this feature and how it fits with the project's goal of being a lightweight, local-first experiment tracker.
